name: PS5CEMU-HAR
summary: Two Nintendo generations in one app: Cemu for Wii U and Azahar for 3DS.
description: Combines Cemu (Wii U) and Azahar (3DS) under one homebrew title. Wii U games run at up to 2160p with graphic packs and GamePad touch on the DualSense touchpad; the 3DS side emulates a New 3DS with save states, cheats and network play.
author: premohq
warnings: Cemu and Azahar never run at the same time.
Amiibo dumps must be supplied by the user.
